name: The Internship
source:
Young talented student Carli applies for a job as an assistant to a business lady Jan. They are not gay, but one night may change their lives... Read and find out what happened once in an office!

[From Steam (removed)]
translation:
年轻的才华横溢的学生卡莉申请了一份工作，担任一位商界女士简的助理。他们不是同性恋，但一个晚上可能会改变他们的生活……阅读并找出办公室里发生的事情！

[来自Steam（已删除）]
